The archive foliation is 8 at the lower left; it is a comment only. H's page number, editorial section title Ensembles à permutation, and ink-colour note are not manuscript wording.

Whole image 1689 x 2362 was viewed once, then half a and half b once each, in that order. The halves were not reopened. Fourteen enhanced tight crops were then inspected; the crop manifest records original boxes, rotations and reasons. Only the left-note crop was rotated, by +27 degrees.

All 23 original C doubt loci have an explicit resolve or retain disposition. Two further doubts were added: the compressed first subgroup word in the right note, and the faint detached V-like trace in the classification continuation.
The author's own question mark after S5 is live text. The cancellation of the A4 list and the first product law is preserved; the A4 label itself is live.
The family is called a_i and then n_i. No correction of that switch was supplied. The visible terminal q in the first sequence and the awkward identity annotation are also retained.
C's coté spelling is retained. H's different Rectification parenthesis, expanded abbreviations, and incomplete lower-left note are substantive collation differences.

The left margin is explicitly selected in LaTeX. Both oblique margin dividers and the short parallel stroke beside the right divider are drawn, without giving the strokes an invented mathematical interpretation.

The pale V-like trace is not securely attributable to writing. It is represented as a doubtful detached mark so the uncertainty is reviewable; its position is below the line, not ordinary comma position.

The mathematical checks listed separately were actually reasoned through. The circular-order parenthesis and a complete proof of the subgroup correspondence were read but not independently proved here.

H's declared bold encodings for doubled number fields and macro differences alone were not counted as collation errors. Where H uses plain Z and the ink is doubled, the alphabet difference is recorded.

No other page or reader, OCR, recognition library, PDF text layer, web source, or published text was consulted. No TeX compilation was performed; the final self-check is structural and coverage based.

checks.statement: S row SA01-K75-01: the stated orbit-count condition does not imply transitivity.
checks.reasoning: For u=(12)(34) on {1,2,3,4}, the orbits are {1,2} and {3,4}. Thus n_2=2 and every other n_i is zero: all n_i except at most one vanish, while there are two orbits.
checks.outcome: The manuscript equivalence is false in its sufficient direction. The row is confirmed, and the ink is preserved.

checks.statement: The displayed symmetric-group counts and representatives for n=2,3,4.
checks.reasoning: The partitions of 2 have types 1+1 and 2; of 3, 1+1+1, 2+1 and 3; of 4, 1+1+1+1, 2+1+1, 2+2, 3+1 and 4. These correspond to the listed identity, transposition, double transposition, 3-cycle and 4-cycle representatives where applicable.
checks.outcome: Counts 2,3,5 and their displayed representatives agree. No answer is supplied to the author's S5 question mark.

checks.statement: The A2 and A3 table entries, and the primary canceled A4 4-cycle.
checks.reasoning: A2 contains only the identity. A3 consists of 1,(123),(321) and is abelian, so these give three singleton conjugacy classes. A 4-cycle has sign (-1)^3=-1.
checks.outcome: The live A2/A3 counts agree. If the canceled last index is 1234, it gives an odd permutation; this observation was not used to resolve its first digit or infer a reason for the cancellation.

checks.statement: The literal qp core in the first annotation.
checks.reasoning: The displayed p goes G to Gamma and q goes Gamma to G. With ordinary composition, qp therefore maps G to G, whereas id_Gamma maps Gamma to Gamma. The extra initial retraced letter and detached final q prevent a secure complete correction reading.
checks.outcome: A literal qp=id_Gamma is not type-consistent. The transcription retains the observed sequence of marks and does not replace it by the expected pq.

checks.statement: Associativity of the live product formula under the displayed action hypothesis.
checks.reasoning: Writing alpha_gamma for int(gamma), the first coordinate of ((z,gamma)(zprime,gammaprime))(zsecond,gammasecond) is z alpha_gamma(zprime) alpha_{gamma gammaprime}(zsecond). The other parenthesization gives z alpha_gamma(zprime alpha_gammaprime(zsecond)), equal because alpha is an action by automorphisms; the second coordinates both equal gamma gammaprime gammasecond.
checks.outcome: The live multiplication has the usual associative semidirect-product form under that hypothesis. This check does not settle the looped z-prime alphabet or any stray annotation.
